=== ISSUE LATER-01
title: [LATER-01] Files (PDF) reader
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:library
milestone: P7 Later features
---
**Phase:** P7 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** later (reader in the first hub version, v118 marks it Later) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{BM-01}}, {{DATA-01d}}

## Goal
Save a PDF, read it with pages and highlights, and get a summary.

## Proposed change
- Save a PDF into the files folder, extract its text, add it to word search, and summarize it through the save task.
- A reader with pages and highlights.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A PDF is saved and its text can be searched.
- [ ] A quote shown from the PDF exists in the PDF text.

## Out of scope
- Scanned PDFs with no text layer, unless the owner asks.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, LATER-01: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, PDF reader (first hub version): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE LIFE-02
title: [LIFE-02] Diary with passcode
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:life
milestone: P7 Later features
---
**Phase:** P7 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v74 to v77) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{DATA-01b}}, {{APP-02}}

## Goal
A locked diary that only the owner can read.

## Proposed change
- Diary entries in Markdown with a mood per entry.
- The text is encrypted with a key made from the passcode. The passcode is never stored.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Diary text is unreadable in the data files without the passcode.
- [ ] Diary text is never sent to Claude unless the owner asks.
- [ ] Diary text is not in the word search index while the diary is locked.

## Out of scope
- Passcode recovery. A lost passcode means lost entries. Say this clearly in the app.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, LIFE-02 and DEC-05: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, Diary (v74 to v77): {{PROTO}}
- This is the only place where the app encrypts data. Get the design reviewed before you build it.

=== ISSUE LATER-07
title: [LATER-07] Background runner after Quit
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P7 Later features
---
**Phase:** P7 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** not started · **Size:** L (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-01}}

## Goal
Jobs run on schedule even after the owner quits Mnemo.

## Proposed change
- A small runner started by the system (launchd on macOS, systemd on Ubuntu) that uses the same storage module and the same queue rules.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A scheduled job runs after Quit.
- [ ] The runner stops at the usage limit like any other job.
- [ ] The runner and the app never write to the database in an unsafe way. The two-writer test is extended to two processes.

## Out of scope
- Running when the computer is off.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, LATER-07 and DEC-08 (the owner's decision of 2026-11-18): {{ROADMAP}}
- Architecture, "Job nền" (no system service in version 1): {{ARCH}}

=== ISSUE LAST-01
title: [LAST-01] API key mode
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:ai
milestone: P8 Last
---
**Phase:** P8 (last) · **Roadmap status:** later (v52, v103 "Coming soon", v119, v120) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{AI-01b}}, {{AI-02}}

## Goal
Run AI with the owner's own API key in place of the subscription, with a spend guard.

## Proposed change
- A second source for the AI runner that uses an API key. The runner interface from {{AI-01b}} stays the same.
- A spend guard: warn at $60, stop at $80.
- The key is read from `MNEMO_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the computer's environment or in `~/.config/mnemo/.env`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The key is saved in the computer's env or a local config file. No keychain and no encryption (the owner's decision of 2026-11-18).
- [ ] At the stop line, links are saved with no summary.
- [ ] The key never appears in logs, in the database or in an export.

## Out of scope
- Other AI providers.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, LAST-01: {{ROADMAP}}
- Architecture, "DEC-06" (API credit is used only with an API key) and "Rủi ro" (API key mode is the way out if the subscription rules change): {{ARCH}}
